papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.37137v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reduced and mixed precision have moved from a niche optimization to a central design axis in scientific computing and engineering, driven by energy constraints, heterogeneous accelerators, and the convergence of simulation and machine learning. This paper organizes the landscape around seven coupled themes---number formats, floating-point emulation, emerging architectures, hardware/software co-design, relation to other approximations, software design, and precision as a multilevel resource ---and, for each theme, synthesizes the state of the art, future directions, and open questions.
